description:
Find companies by name, sector or country, to get the company id that `company`, `relationships` and the entity tools take
    (relays GET /api/v1/companies). Returns {count, total, companies[{id, name, sector, country, country_code, description, lat, lng,
    as_of}], charged_joules}, ordered by name; `total` counts every match, `companies` is one page (limit + offset). Each row says if it
    is unconfirmed. One price per call at the basic class. Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

country.description: Country as an ISO code or a name; USA, US and United States find the same companies.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 100. Default 50.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

search.description: Part of the company's name (case-insensitive substring match), e.g. "rio tinto".
search.title: Search

name: company_search
